description: Canonical metadata for a daily seed, rotating bounty, Game Jam contest, or tournament bracket published in a game's repository.

main.description: Defines a bounded or recurring challenge offered by a game (e.g. Daily Climb seed, Wordle/puzzle #142, 2-week ATProto Game Jam high-score sprint, or weekly boss bounty). Links cleanly to `leaderboard.definition` (via `leaderboard` + `seed` + `dimensions`) and optional `achievement.definition` rewards (`rewardAchievement`).

game.description: AT-URI of the game definition record (`games.atmosphere.define`) in the publisher's repository.

title.description: Display title of the challenge (e.g. `Daily Seed #142: Glass Cannon`, `ATProto Game Jam Sprint`).

description.description: Rules, modifiers, or objectives for this challenge.

translations.description: Optional localized `title` and `description` strings keyed by BCP-47 language tag.

icon.description: Optional square badge or banner art for this challenge.

cadence.description: Recurrence or lifecycle category of this challenge.

seed.description: Optional deterministic world/puzzle seed token matched by `leaderboard.score#seed`.

targetSteps.description: Optional numeric objective threshold for quest/bounty completion.

leaderboard.description: Optional AT-URI of the `games.opengaming.leaderboard.definition` ranking runs for this challenge.

rewardAchievement.description: Optional AT-URI of a `games.opengaming.achievement.definition` (typically `countsTowardCompletion: false` when time-limited) awarded for completing this challenge.

dimensions.description: Optional pinned sub-board dimensions/modifiers required for runs in this challenge (e.g. `{ "mode": "4k", "modifiers": "mirror" }`).

startsAt.description: Optional timestamp when the challenge opens.

endsAt.description: Optional timestamp when the challenge closes.
